name: Hex package for authoring and playing demos in Phoenix apps

mentions.name: Hex package for authoring and playing demos in Phoenix apps
mentions.description: A small Hex package that lets developers author and play interactive demos directly inside a Phoenix app, with demo scripts that can be written by AI or by hand.
mentions.source_excerpt:
While working on it, I realized I should build a small Hex package for authoring and playing demos right in a Phoenix app (it's very easy to author scripts with AI or by hand):
